data.name: Echoes of Nature's Song
data.description: A filidh can use his bardic performance to imbue his allies with subconscious knowledge of their own futures, improving their reflexes and ability to avoid danger. An affected ally receives a +%1 insight bonus on Reflex saving throws and to AC. This performance is a mind-affecting ability and relies on audible components. |min(4,(BardLVL+1)/6)
